I hear you, and a month without a straight answer is not acceptable. I have put your case in front of the team with a note that it has been open that long and is still unanswered.

Two things so you know exactly what happens next:

1. The team is offline right now (it is 11pm Eastern). They pick this up tomorrow from 10am ET and the answer goes to your email.
2. If you give me your order number here, I will add it to the case so they do not have to come back and ask you for it.

And if any part of this is actually about the hardware itself (setup, hashrate, errors, firmware), tell me the model and what it is doing and I will work on that with you right now.
